basic_info.description: Welcome to the epitome of luxury living in Twin Peaks! This stunning townhouse-style condo is perfectly situated just steps away from the vibrant amenities of Noe Valley and the Castro. Featuring 2 bedrooms plus an office/den and 2.5 baths, this home features floor-to-ceiling windows that flood the space with natural light and offer breathtaking views from downtown to the Oakland Hills. The main level, a spacious living room seamlessly flowing into the adjacent dining area, creating an open layout ideal for entertaining. The updated galley kitchen is equipped with stainless steel appliances and opens to a private patio, perfect for outdoor relaxation. The lower level includes a generous primary bedroom, a second bedroom, and an additional room that can serve as an office or guest room. This level also features a full bath, a laundry room, and ample storage. Experience the best of urban living with easy access to local shops, restaurants, and public transportation. This home is a rare find in a highly sought-after Twin Peaks neighborhood. Don't miss the opportunity to make this your home.  .
